survey.title: Quick learning feedback
survey.objective: Help the facilitator choose one improvement and identify needs for follow-up practice before repeating this learning experience.
survey.target_audience: People who participated in the named course or live workshop; report completion status separately if reliably known.
survey.owner: Facilitator of the named learning experience

consent.text: Your feedback is optional and helps improve the next learning experience. You may skip any question or close the form. Please do not include personal information in your comments.
consent.contact: Contact the facilitator through the course or workshop contact channel.

privacy.retention: Draft assumption: owner must set and disclose retention and response access before fielding.
privacy.security_notes: Conservative handling classification until the destination is inspected; not a finding about actual collection. Verify account linkage, logging, context combinations and incidental identifiers in free text. Do not promise anonymity.

decisions: Facilitator chooses the next experience improvement and whether to offer follow-up practice.
exclusions: Confirmed technical retry duplicates; preserve the intended submission
analysis_plan.sample_size_basis: Invite eligible participants; descriptive feedback, no representativeness or statistical power claim.
analysis_plan.missing_data_plan: Show a valid-answer denominator for each item. Keep skips and NA distinct from numeric ratings; do not impute.
analysis_plan.open_text_plan: Code improvement suggestions by actionable theme and redact identifying details before sharing.
decision_rules: Review each reported obstacle before the next run; select an actionable improvement with the owner, using rating distributions and context. No unsupported pass/fail threshold.

questions.text: Overall, how would you rate this learning experience?
questions.rationale: Review the rating distribution to decide whether the experience needs investigation before repeating it.
questions.analysis_use: Review the rating distribution to decide whether the experience needs investigation before repeating it.

questions.text: How confident are you that you can use what this learning experience covered?
questions.rationale: Identify whether participants report needing follow-up practice or support; this is not a test of learning.
questions.analysis_use: Identify whether participants report needing follow-up practice or support; this is not a test of learning.

choices.label: Not applicable — I did not cover enough to judge

questions.text: What is one thing we could improve for next time?
questions.rationale: Code suggestions into actionable themes for the next revision; do not treat comment counts as population prevalence.
questions.analysis_use: Code suggestions into actionable themes for the next revision; do not treat comment counts as population prevalence.

platform_notes.privacy: No identifier is requested, but optional free text may contain identifying information. Restrict access and redact before sharing.

metadata.scale_provenance: New wording and fully specified choices; not copied as a validated scale from the game survey.

context_contract.experience_id: Resolve the named experience from trusted metadata.

metadata.presentation: One page. Show the resolved experience title/date above the shared questions. One minute is an untested target.
release_checks: Resolve privacy, retention, owner contact and jurisdiction
Verify both paths, persistence, access controls and data export
metadata.context_analysis: Report counts by experience, instrument version and collection source from the response envelope; avoid pooled claims without a population rationale.
metadata.privacy_status: unverified; handle as identified data until reviewed
